from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Divider color 4 forms complete rows/columns; the remaining rectangles are tiles.
    div = 4
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == div for v in grid[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == div for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for x in cuts:
            if start < x: out.append((start,x))
            start=x+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rows=spans(h,row_cuts); cols=spans(w,col_cuts)
    bg=grid[0][0]
    source=None
    for r0,r1 in rows:
        for c0,c1 in cols:
            if any(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != div for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
                source=(r0,r1,c0,c1); break
        if source: break
    if source is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=source
    pattern=[grid[r][c0:c1] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b in rows:
        for x,y in cols:
            for i,r in enumerate(range(a,b)):
                for j,c in enumerate(range(x,y)):
                    out[r][c]=pattern[i % len(pattern)][j % len(pattern[0])]
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-6c9b01ad.py'
path.write_text(code)
